snippet.title: Success in Tech
snippet.description:
Do you want to know how to communicate effectively with your boss or co-workers? Which soft skills do you need to be a successful engineer?
How to become a software developer? Do I need to be good at math to become a developer?
How to negotiate salary? 
Others get promoted faster than you and you don't know why? 
SiT (Success in Tech) provides you with answers for all of those questions, No matter if you are a Software Engineer, Web Developer, QA Engineer, Data Scientist etc. 

Subscribe to this channel and achieve more in your tech career!

This channel is not endorsed by any companies, views  are my own.
